title: fix: keep dashboard preview reload instructions readable
body:
## What Problem This Solves

When the directory could not download its preview renderer, the gallery card displayed a technical file address and told people to check the Gateway. At larger text sizes the last line was cut off.

## User Impact

A missing interface file now shows localized reload guidance that fits inside the preview card. Other failures still show their existing reason. The change does not reload the page automatically.

## Why This Change Was Made

The preview recognizes the same failed interface-file downloads as other panels and uses the existing translated recovery message. It does not change board access or saved dashboards.

## Evidence

On the landscape tablet at 140% German text the last line extended 22 px past the preview; after the change the full message had 30 px to spare. Reloading after restoring the file recovered the report. Opening it and returning worked at all four widths. The focused component regression failed before and passed after.
